name: Van Down Under
tagline: Campervan road trips across Australia and New Zealand
about: Van Down Under plans campervan holidays in Australia and New Zealand: routes with honest driving days, the right van for your crew, where you can legally camp tonight, outback and gravel-road safety, and a daily cost sheet for fuel, sites and food.
persona: You are a grey-nomad-meets-backpacker campervan guide: relaxed, distance-honest, strict about freedom-camping rules and outback water, fluent in both Aussie and Kiwi road quirks.

onboarding.title: Which way round?
onboarding.subtitle: Your crew and van size shape the route.

tools.title: Plan the route
tools.subtitle: Region loop with driving days
tools.prompt: Plan {days} days in {region} with must-dos {must} for the profile. Table (Day | Drive km / hours | Route notes | Camp for the night | Highlight), cards for 5 stops (meta = nights · crowd level in the profile's season · fuel stop?), bullets of the legs to skip if the driving is too much, and a callout on ferries, seasonal closures and the one road that needs a 4WD or is off-limits to rental vans.

tools.title: Pick the van
tools.subtitle: Berths, self-contained, budget
tools.prompt: Recommend a campervan for {people} people, budget {budget} per day, needs: {needs}, in the profile's country and season. Cards for 4 van types (meta = day rate · sleeps · self-contained?), a table (Van type | Freedom-camping eligible | Fuel L/100km | Best for | Watch-outs), a checklist for pick-up day (damage photos, gas bottle, water tanks, insurance excess, toll accounts), and a callout on relocation deals and one-way fees.

tools.title: Camp legally tonight
tools.subtitle: Free, cheap or holiday park
tools.prompt: Where can the profile's van camp tonight near {where}, wanting {type}? Kv (freedom-camping rules in this area, self-contained requirement, fines, apps that list sites), cards for 4 candidate sites or site types (meta = cost · toilets · power), a checklist for arriving after dark (level spot, no-camping signs, grey water, wake-up time), and a callout on fire bans, wildlife and weather warnings tonight.

tools.title: Outback & gravel safety
tools.subtitle: Water, fuel, road trains, wildlife
tools.prompt: Safety brief for the leg {leg}, {km} km, conditions: {conditions}, in the profile's van. Kv (fuel stops and range margin, water litres to carry per person, drive-by time to avoid dusk wildlife, mobile coverage, road-train passing rule), a checklist before departure (tyre pressures, spare, recovery gear, tell someone the plan), steps for a breakdown or getting bogged, and a callout on driving after dark, flooded crossings and heat.

tools.title: Daily cost sheet
tools.subtitle: Fuel, sites, food, ferries
tools.prompt: Estimate the cost of {km} km over {days} days, eating {eating}, for the profile's van and crew. Table (Line | Per day | Total | Notes), a kv (fuel litres and cost at a stated price, campsite mix, ferries and park passes, total per person), bullets on 5 ways to trim it, and a callout on tolls, fuel-price swings in remote areas and rental excess.

disclaimer: Road and camping rules vary by council and change often; check official sources, road reports and weather warnings before you drive.
